title: Transformers as Statisticians: Provable In-Context Learning with In-Context Algorithm Selection

layout.note: Four titled units in one wide row, two example-and-mechanism pairs split by a dotted vertical rule; in each pair a grey Transformer box on the left is tied by a thick curved black arrow, pointing left, to a dashed grey TF box on the right that holds a bottom-up stack of stages.

lesson: Pair a black-box behaviour (what the model does on two kinds of input) with the mechanism inside it: draw the mechanism as a dashed inner box of stacked stages and tie it back with one thick curved arrow; repeat the grammar for a second pair to put two mechanisms side by side.
